 Bench At Aurangabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Both the Criminal Applications are filed for quashing of FIR in Crime Nos. 77/2018 and 78/2018 registered with Taloda Police Station, Dist. Nandurbar as well as the further proceedings in R.C.C.
Nos. 40/2018 and 41/2018 respectively pending before the Judicial Magistrate First Class, Taloda for offence punishable under Section 420 of the Indian Penal Code.
123-124.odt 1 of 2 2.

The gist of allegation against the applicants is that property mortgaged by them towards security of term loan advanced to them has been sold out by them so as to defraud informant/complainant from recovery of loan.

In pursuance to the FIR the investigation has been completed, charge-sheet Pralhad S/O Mohan Patil vs The State Of Maharashtra And Anr. on 5 January, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/86788076/
1 has been filed.

entities.text: charge-sheet Pralhad S/O Mohan Patil vs The State Of Maharashtra And Anr
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is informed that even charge has been framed.
3. It is not the contention of applicants that they had not obtained the loan from bank or that the property was not mortgaged as security for loan.
Applicants contends that there are other properties mortgaged with the bank and applicants have not defaulted in repayment of loan installments.
Such contention cannot be considered at this stage.
The applicants would be entitled to raise their defence during the course of trial.
Prima facie averment in FIR and material in charge- sheet is sufficient to make out triable case against applicants.
4. In that view of the matter, criminal applications sans merit, hence rejected.
Pralhad S/O Mohan Patil vs The State Of Maharashtra And Anr.
